business_critical.label: Critical
business_critical.description: The activity tolerates at most four hours of interruption.

high.label: High
high.description: The activity tolerates more than four hours, up to one day of interruption.

medium.label: Moderate
medium.description: The activity tolerates more than one day, up to three days of interruption.

low.label: Low
low.description: The activity tolerates more than three days of interruption.

low.label: Low
low.description: Limited, local consequences of a compromise.

high.label: High
high.description: Major harm to data, an important activity or several systems.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Catastrophic consequences, serious harm to people or the environment, or widespread compromise of information systems.

internal.label: Internal
internal.description: Information intended for internal use; disclosure has limited consequences.

confidential.label: Confidential
confidential.description: Disclosure could cause significant harm; access is limited to authorised recipients.

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.description: Disclosure could cause severe harm; access is strictly limited to those who need it.

vital.label: V1: Vital activities
vital.description: Restore vital activities after their prerequisites.
